context.person: A person using a roadside assistance application
context.user_goal: Contact the provider for current conditions or cancel if another safe option is available.

product_state.preceding_state: A tow provider accepted the request but traffic prevents a reliable arrival estimate.
product_state.current_state: The request is active. A provider is assigned.
known_facts: No reliable arrival time is available.
The driver can call the provider or cancel without a fee before arrival.

current_content.heading: Still working
current_content.body: We're working on it. Check again later.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product status card so the person can understand roadside assistance arrival time unknown, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Cancel the active request before arrival.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The person must wait without a confirmed arrival time.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Contact the provider for current conditions or cancel if another safe option is available.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
